title: MSHEM-06.01 General EHSS Rules
body: The breach nobody calls out because nothing happened is the one that sets the precedent for the next. At ADW that looks like a skipped brake check or a truck speeding on the ramp getting waved through until someone gets hurt.
keyPoints: Enforce every rule every time it's broken, not only after a loss. Outcome doesn't excuse the breach (§5.1.11).
Where local regulation and MSHEM differ, the stricter requirement is the floor. Brief your crews to the tighter one.
Anyone unsure of a procedure or hazard asks, without fear or favour (§5.1.15). That's the everyday partner to the right to stop work.
Every recommended action needs a named owner and a target date. First change to a due date goes to Director level; later changes go to SVP.
apply: Pre-start brake tests and ramp speed: if an operator skips the check or runs hot on the ramp, correct it on the spot and log it, so it doesn't become "that's how we do it" by the end of the week.
